title: science(toe): complete nonlinear metric Ward embedding
science: Block 61: identifies and removes the rank-five nonlinear coordinate reaction in the fixed Regge candidate, proving the square-root metric-completion identity on all 55 symmetric constant-metric tangent pairs; the completed force scales quadratically and the Ward projection cubically on a less-symmetric winding.
carried_by: #6155 carries the fixed completion (reaction Ward max 9.6e-16) into the complete six-dimensional multimode bases and restates the k^2/k^3 scalings there; ancestry of #7753
